claims.text: The resort is a water village set in the Xixi Wetlands Nature Reserve in Hangzhou.

findings.quote: Enter into an authentic water village set in the picturesque Xixi Wetlands Nature Reserve - a Hangzhou haven found near the west lake.
findings.note: The page describes a water village set in the Xixi Wetlands Nature Reserve in Hangzhou.

claims.text: The resort is built in traditional Jiangnan architecture amid water village surroundings.

findings.quote: Traditional Jiangnan architecture and serene water village surroundings create an atmosphere that captures the region’s heritage.
findings.note: Both the Jiangnan architecture and the water village surroundings are stated.

claims.text: Xixi Wetland is a 5-minute walk from the resort.

findings.quote: Xixi Wetland: This scenic spot in Hangzhou is just a 5-minute walk from the resort.
findings.note: The 5-minute walk matches the claim.

claims.text: The resort is 7 km from the city centre of Hangzhou.

findings.quote: We are conveniently situated just 7 km away from the city centre of Hangzhou, China.
findings.note: The 7 km distance matches the claim.

claims.text: Lingyin Temple, the oldest Buddhist temple in Hangzhou, is around 5.5 km from the resort.

findings.quote: Lingyin Temple: The oldest Buddhist temple in Hangzhou, dating all the way back to the 4th century, is around 5.5 km away from the resort.
findings.note: Both the description and the 5.5 km distance match the claim.

claims.text: The Premier Water View Villa has a private courtyard and views of the wetlands or lake.

findings.quote: Villa with a private courtyard and views of the wetlands or lake
findings.note: This is the description of the Premier Water View Villa.

claims.text: The Premier Water Terrace Suite has an in-room bathtub and a private spa treatment room.

findings.quote: Spacious suite with king-size bed, in-room bathtub and a private spa treatment room
findings.note: This is the description of the Premier Water Terrace Suite.

claims.text: The three-bedroom Ambassador Villa is set by a scenic riverbank and welcomes guests with an in-villa banquet in the tradition of Chinese feasts.

findings.quote: The Ambassador Villa celebrates your arrival with an exclusive In-Villa banquet served in the time-honoured tradition of Chinese feasts.

findings.quote: Fitness Centre

findings.quote: The library has an excellent selection of classic novels, and features retro décor including an antique typewriter and a vintage phonograph.
findings.note: Every element of the claim is covered.

claims.text: Wellbeing activities include baduanjin, biking and yoga, including a leisurely bike ride around Xixi Wetland.

findings.quote: our calendar of activities — including baduanjin, biking, yoga and more — are an expression of harmony between self and nature.

findings.quote: Embrace nature through a leisurely cycle around Xixi Wetland.
findings.note: The page describes the Wetland Bike Ride around Xixi Wetland.

claims.text: Bai Yun is a Chinese restaurant serving authentic local Hangzhou dishes.

findings.quote: A fine Chinese Restaurant serving authentic local Hangzhou dishes.
findings.note: This is the description of Bai Yun Chinese Restaurant.

claims.text: The Two-Bedroom Family Villa has a large outdoor jetpool, heated floors and deep bathtubs.

findings.quote: A two-bedroom family villa with a large outdoor jetpool, gorgeous interiors, inviting bathrooms, heated floors and deep bathtubs for large groups or couples travelling together.
findings.note: The jetpool, heated floors and deep bathtubs are all stated.

claims.text: The Water Terrace Suite - King has a fireplace, a balcony and wetland views.

findings.quote: A cosy king bed suite with a fireplace, balcony and wetland views
findings.note: This is the description of the Water Terrace Suite – King.

claims.text: The Banyan Tree Spa's signature Banyan Balance treatment uses locally sourced Longjing tea.

findings.quote: Inspired by our poetic city, this experience harnesses locally-sourced Longjing tea, also known as the tea of emperors.
findings.note: The page describes Sense of Place - Banyan Balance as using locally-sourced Longjing tea.

claims.text: Afternoon tea is served aboard a traditional Jiang Nan sculling boat cruising the lake.

findings.quote: Relish scrumptious savories and sweets, complemented by fragrant Chinese tea, as you cruise along the pastoral lake on a traditional “Jiang Nan” sculling boat.
findings.note: This is the description of the Afternoon Tea Sculling Boat.

claims.text: On the Fisherman's Journey guests take a sculling boat to fish with local boatmen and pick vegetables, then eat a lunch cooked with their catch.
